use default
use System.Convert.to_string

divisors(n: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    pipe(1::n) |> filter(d => n % d == 0)

spellings(n: int) -> Pipe[string] =>
    pipe(["{n}", "0b{to_string(n, 2)}"])

write_line(pipe([6]) |> flat_map(divisors) |> join(", "))

write_line(
    pipe([6])
        |> flat_map(divisors)
        |> flat_map(spellings)
        |> join(", "))
